# stremio-core

Parts of `src/core` are C++ ports of [stremio-core](https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-core)'s
logic: the library, add-on and Continue watching models, and the player's
watch-progress rules. No stremio-core source code is bundled here. Its
licence is kept in `LICENSE.md` because the ported code is covered by it.
